findings.issue_text: [Medium/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:10 — `totalPages` uses `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`, which produces a phantom empty page whenever `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g. 100/50 → 3 pages); should be `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`

[Medium/data] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (remove_member) — `group.users.delete(user_id)` removes the join row directly, bypassing destroy callbacks on the GroupUser record, so `user_count` is never decremented and other removal side effects are skipped; the stale `user_count` breaks the pagination UI

[Medium/test_gap] spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb (".remove_member > cannot remove members from automatic groups") — the test uses `xhr :put` but the route maps `DELETE /members` to `remove_member`, so the request actually exercises `add_members`; `remove_member`'s automatic-group guard is never tested and `add_members`' guard is tested twice

[Medium/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 — inside `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` the template context is the member (a User), so `{{#unless automatic}}` looks up `automatic` on the user rather than the group controller; it's always undefined, so the remove link renders even for automatic groups where the server just 422s with no visible feedback

[Medium/bug] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (create) — `create` only reads `name` and `visible` and ignores `alias_level`, even though the client's `asJSON()` now sends it, so newly created groups silently lose the selected alias level until a second manual save

[Medium/api] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb (members) — the response shape changed from a flat serialized array to `{ members: [...], meta: {...} }`, breaking existing API consumers of `GET /groups/:name/members`; related breaking changes in the same PR include removal of the admin PATCH `changes` endpoint and `get "users"` without deprecation

[Medium/bug] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (add_members) — `usernames.split(",")` neither trims whitespace nor reports unknown usernames; `" bob, alice"` silently skips `" alice"`, nonexistent users are dropped with a 200 response giving the admin no feedback, and if `usernames` is sent as an array, `.split` raises a 500

goldens.comment: The findMembers() call is now asynchronous and unhandled. The controller may not have member data immediately available, creating a race condition.

In the next action, capping the next offset at user_count can produce an empty page (e.g., total equal to limit results in offset == total, showing 2/2 with no members). This can cause confusing UX on the last page.
The remove_member test uses xhr :put to call the remove_member action, but the route defines delete 'members' => 'groups#remove_member' requiring DELETE method.

The `totalPages` calculation using `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` produces an extra page when `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit`, leading to incorrect pagination. For example, with 100 users and a limit of 50, it reports 3 pages instead of 2, allowing navigation to an empty page.
Expected to return a value at the end of function - code paths without explicit returns will return undefined

The route provides the group's ID in params[:id], but the code attempts to read it from params[:group_id], causing the action to fail. This results in a broken feature when trying to access group memberships.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/data] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (remove_member) — `group.users.delete(user_id)` removes the join row directly, bypassing destroy callbacks on the GroupUser record, so `user_count` is never decremented and other removal side effects are skipped; the stale `user_count` breaks the pagination UI

adjudication.rationale: The diff does show `remove_member` using `group.users.delete(user_id)`, which in Rails typically skips callbacks on the join model, but the finding’s concrete impact (“user_count is never decremented” and “stale user_count breaks the pagination UI”) isn’t supported by the diff. The new pagination/meta total used by the UI comes from `GroupsController#members`, which computes `total = group.users.count` on every request and returns it in `meta.total`, and the JS `findMembers()` sets `user_count` from that meta. There’s no evidence in the diff of a counter-cache/callback on a `GroupUser` join record that would need to fire to keep `user_count` correct, nor that pagination depends on such callbacks.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 — inside `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` the template context is the member (a User), so `{{#unless automatic}}` looks up `automatic` on the user rather than the group controller; it's always undefined, so the remove link renders even for automatic groups where the server just 422s with no visible feedback

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs` the list is rendered with `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, which establishes the per-item context as the iterated `member` (a `Discourse.User`). In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, the conditional `{{#unless automatic}}` therefore resolves `automatic` against the user object, not the group/controller’s `automatic` flag. Since users don’t have `automatic`, it will be `undefined`/falsy and the remove link will render even for automatic groups, leading to a 422 when clicked (per `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` guarding `group.automatic`).

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (create) — `create` only reads `name` and `visible` and ignores `alias_level`, even though the client's `asJSON()` now sends it, so newly created groups silently lose the selected alias level until a second manual save

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows the client now includes `alias_level` in `Discourse.Group#asJSON()` (group.js: returns `{ name, alias_level, visible }`) and `create()` posts that directly to `/admin/groups` (`Discourse.ajax(... data: this.asJSON())`). However `Admin::GroupsController#create` only assigns `group.name` and `group.visible` and never reads/sets `params[:alias_level]`, while `#update` does handle `alias_level`. This means a non-default alias level selected during creation will be dropped until a later update/save.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/api] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb (members) — the response shape changed from a flat serialized array to `{ members: [...], meta: {...} }`, breaking existing API consumers of `GET /groups/:name/members`; related breaking changes in the same PR include removal of the admin PATCH `changes` endpoint and `get "users"` without deprecation

adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (wrapped payload) in `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`, which is an observable API response-shape change for `GET /groups/:name/members`. The same PR also removes the admin PATCH-style incremental membership update flow (Admin::GroupsController no longer branches on `request.patch?`, and the spec deletes the incremental patch tests) and replaces the admin groups subroute from `get "users"` to `put/delete "members"` in `config/routes.rb`, with no deprecation shown in the diff. These are concrete, diff-grounded compatibility concerns, but not necessarily an internal correctness defect unless backward compatibility is required.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (add_members) — `usernames.split(",")` neither trims whitespace nor reports unknown usernames; `" bob, alice"` silently skips `" alice"`, nonexistent users are dropped with a 200 response giving the admin no feedback, and if `usernames` is sent as an array, `.split` raises a 500

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` is used as-is and then iterated via `usernames.split(",")`. The diff shows no `.strip`/normalization on each username before `User.find_by_username(username)`, so inputs like "bob, alice" will include a leading space and fail lookup, silently skipping intended users. Additionally, since `params[:usernames]` is not type-checked/coerced, if an array is submitted (e.g., `usernames[]=bob&usernames[]=alice`), calling `.split` on an Array would raise `NoMethodError` (500). Unknown usernames are also dropped without feedback, returning 200 on successful save.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js (removeMember) — after removing the last member of the final page, `offset` is not adjusted; `findMembers` clamps against the stale `user_count`, leaving the UI on an empty page beyond `totalPages`

adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#removeMember`, after the DELETE it simply calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset`. In `findMembers`, the requested offset is clamped using the *current* `this.get("user_count")` (which is stale until the AJAX response returns): `var ... offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0));`. If you delete the last member on the last page (e.g., offset=50, limit=50, old total=51 -> new total=50), `findMembers()` will still request `offset=50`, and the server will return an empty `members` list (since offset==total). The model then gets set to `members: []` with `offset` unchanged, leaving the UI on an empty page beyond the real last page.

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb (update) — `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` means any PUT that omits `visible` silently resets it to false, so a partial update destroys data for API clients that only send `name`/`alias_level`

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#update`, the diff unconditionally assigns `group.visible = params[:visible] == "true"` (no presence check), so when `visible` is omitted from the request, `params[:visible]` is `nil` and the expression evaluates to `false`, overwriting a previously-true `visible` value. This creates silent data loss for partial updates (e.g., updating only `name`/`alias_level`).

adjudication_records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/components/admin-group-selector.hbs:1 — the component is now a bare `<input type="text">` with no value binding or wiring; it renders a dead, non-functional field wherever used

adjudication.rationale: The diff for `admin-group-selector.hbs` only removes surrounding blank lines; the template was already just `<input type="text">` before this PR. No value binding/wiring was removed or introduced here, so the finding that it is "now" a dead/non-functional field is not supported by the diff.
